{{Quote|You did last longer than any previous chief advisor, you know.|A guard to the advisor|<ref name="Droids (1995) 6">[[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids'' (1995) 6]]</ref>}}
This '''chief advisor''' served [[Craw]], the [[Dictator-Forever]] of [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]], for a time. He was one in a line of many. He was influenced by a drug that made him a "[[Smilers|Smiler]]." In [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]], the advisor was fired by Craw, who was later attacked by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

==Behind the scenes==
The chief advisor was first shown in the comic [[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids (1995)'' 6]], which was released in [[1995]].
